state_busy: Another installation or restore is running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
vdf_closing_brace: Steam's settings contain an unexpected closing brace. Save the settings in Steam, then try again.
vdf_missing_item: A key or value is missing from Steam's settings. Save the settings in Steam, then try again.
vdf_duplicate: Steam's settings contain duplicate keys. Include this error in a bug report.
vdf_missing_value: A value is missing from Steam's settings. Save the settings in Steam, then try again.
vdf_truncated: Steam's settings file is incomplete. Save the settings in Steam, then try again.
vdf_structure: This Steam settings structure is unsupported. Include this error in a bug report.
steam_missing: Steam was not found. Specify its directory with --steam-root.
game_missing: The Steam edition of Resonite was not found. Check that it is installed and that the selected directory is correct.
steam_endpoint_invalid: This Steam settings endpoint is unsupported. Include this error in a bug report.
steam_handshake_large: Steam's connection response is too large. Include this error in a bug report.
steam_connect_failed: Could not connect to Steam. Restart Steam, then try again.
steam_disconnected: The connection to Steam was lost. Check that Steam is running.
steam_response_large: Steam's response is too large. Include this error in a bug report.
steam_response_invalid: This Steam response format is unsupported. Include this error in a bug report.
steam_endpoint_missing: The Steam settings endpoint was not found. Check that Steam is running.
steam_api_failed: Steam could not read or write its settings. Check Steam for an error.
steam_no_response: Steam did not return its settings. Check that its interface is responding.
steam_app_unavailable: Could not read Resonite's settings from Steam. Open Resonite's library page in Steam, then try again.
steam_account_ambiguous: Could not select a Steam account. Use --user-id with the account number from Steam's userdata directory.
steam_live_unavailable: Could not read settings from the running Steam client. Restart Steam, then try again.
steam_settings_unavailable: Could not verify Steam's settings. Check that its interface is responding.
steam_settings_changed: Steam's settings changed during the operation. Finish editing them, then try again.
steam_apply_incomplete: Steam's settings were not applied correctly. Run --uninstall to restore the original state, then try again.
steam_must_close: Steam is running. Close Steam, then try again.
steam_race: Steam started or its settings changed during the operation. Close Steam and finish editing its settings, then try again.
steam_verify_failed: Steam's settings do not match the requested values. Check the settings, then try again.
launch_options_unrecognized: Could not update the existing launch options automatically. Check them in Resonite's Steam properties.
launch_options_custom: The launch options contain a custom %command% wrapper. Save a copy and remove that wrapper, then try again.
bootstrap_unsupported: This LinuxBootstrap.sh structure is unsupported. Download the latest installer.
bootstrap_dotnet_missing: The .NET command was not found in Resonite's startup script. Download the latest installer.
path_is_directory: A directory occupies a required file path. Check the selected location: {path}
upgrade_file_changed: A file to be updated has changed. Review the changes before trying again: {path}
install_file_race: A file changed during installation. Finish editing it before trying again: {path}
upgrade_settings_changed: Steam settings to be updated have changed. Review them before trying again.
steam_write_race: Steam's settings changed while being written. Close Steam, then try again.
restore_file_changed: A file has changed since installation. Review the installation record and restore it manually: {path}
backup_changed: A saved backup has changed and cannot be restored automatically. Restore from another backup manually.
restore_file_race: A file changed during restore. Finish editing it, then run --uninstall again: {path}
restore_steam_running: Steam is running. Close Steam, then run --uninstall again.
download_https_required: The download URL does not use HTTPS. Include this error in a bug report.
download_too_large: The download exceeded the expected size. Include this error in a bug report.
download_hash_mismatch: The download did not match the expected contents. Run the installer again to download it again.
archive_unsafe: The archive contains an entry that cannot be extracted. Include this error in a bug report.
archive_too_large: The extracted archive exceeds the expected size. Include this error in a bug report.
runtime_version_invalid: Could not read Resonite's .NET version. Include this error in a bug report.
runtime_framework_unsupported: This Resonite .NET framework configuration is unsupported. Download an updated installer.
runtime_policy_unsupported: Resonite's .NET version selection policy is unsupported. Include this error in a bug report.
runtime_url_invalid: The .NET download location could not be verified. Include this error in a bug report.
runtime_arch_invalid: The downloaded .NET runtime is not an ARM64 build for Frame. Include this error in a bug report.
library_missing: A required library was not found on Frame. Include this name in a bug report: {pattern}
library_arch_invalid: A library on Frame is not an ARM64 build. Check this file: {source}
library_path_invalid: Could not determine the library destination. Include this error in a bug report.
library_dependency_missing: A library dependency is missing. Include this file name in a bug report: {source}
mikk_probe_failed: The mikktspace model library is not working correctly. Include this error in a bug report.
mikk_arch_invalid: The built mikktspace library is not an ARM64 build for Frame. Include this error in a bug report.
cmp_source_unsupported: This image conversion library source is unsupported. Download the latest installer.
cmp_header_unsupported: This image conversion library header is unsupported. Download the latest installer.
cmp_preparing: Preparing image conversion. This takes a few minutes.
cmp_build_failed: Could not build the image conversion libraries. Include this log in a bug report: {log}
cmp_arch_invalid: The built image conversion library is not an ARM64 build for Frame. Include this error in a bug report.
deno_archive_invalid: This Deno archive structure is unsupported. Download the latest installer.
deno_hash_mismatch: The extracted Deno binary did not match the expected contents. Include this error in a bug report.
video_arch_invalid: A video tool is not an ARM64 build for Frame. Include this name in a bug report: {name}
launch_incomplete: The previous installation is incomplete. Run --uninstall to restore the original state, then run the installer again.
launch_file_missing: A required startup file is missing. Run --uninstall to restore the original state, then reinstall: {relative}
launch_bootstrap_changed: Resonite's startup script has changed. Reinstall using a compatible installer.
launch_command_missing: No startup command was provided. Start Resonite from Steam.
already_uninstalled: The original state has already been restored.
uninstall_game_running: Resonite is running. Close it, then run --uninstall again.
restore_steam_open_required: Steam must be running to restore this installation. Start Steam, then run --uninstall again.
restore_launch_options_changed: Resonite's launch options have changed since installation. Review them in Steam's properties and restore them manually.
restore_steam_closed_required: Steam must be closed to restore this installation. Close Steam, then run --uninstall again.
uninstall_complete: Restored the original files and Steam settings.
install_game_running: Resonite is running. Close it, then apply the setup again.
game_updating: Steam is installing or updating Resonite. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
command_missing: The required command {command} was not found. Install it, then try again.
proton_missing: Proton Experimental was not found. Install it from your Steam library, then try again.
already_installed: Already installed. Start Resonite from Steam.
upgrade_environment_changed: Steam's directory or running state differs from installation. Use the same directory and running state, then try again.
managed_files_changed: Files or Steam settings have changed since installation. Review the installation record and restore them manually before trying again.
install_incomplete: The previous installation is incomplete. Run --uninstall to restore the original state, then apply the setup again.
install_preparing: Preparing the files needed for installation.
install_staging_race: Resonite or Steam changed during preparation. Wait for the game and updates to stop, finish editing settings, then try again.
install_game_race: Resonite is running. Close it, run --uninstall to restore the original state, then apply the setup again.
install_failed:

platform_unsupported: This device is unsupported. Run the installer in Steam Frame's terminal.
root_unsupported: Run as the user who uses Steam, without sudo.
manifest_missing: The installation record needed for restore was not found. If you used --state-dir during installation, specify the same directory.
runtime_unavailable: No ARM64 runtime meets the requirement for .NET {version}. Check that the game update is complete, then try again later.

menu_terminal: Open the menu in a terminal, or use --install, --check or --uninstall directly.
menu_missing: whiptail is missing. Use --install, --check or --uninstall directly.
menu_recover: The previous installation is incomplete. Check its state or restore the original state.
menu_failed: Could not display the menu. Use --install, --check or --uninstall directly.
check_ready: The required startup files are present.
check_incomplete: Some required items are missing. Update the setup using the installer.
video_update_required: Run the Resonite Frame installer to update yt-dlp.
